s: The correct form of the address for the President of India is
x: The notes say 'His Excellency' was dropped in 2012 and the form is now 'Rashtrapati ji' / 'Hon'ble President'. They do not support the keyed answer, so no line is linked.

s: The person who got the highest majority in Presidential elections till now is
x: K.R. Narayanan (1997) won about 95% of electoral-college votes, the record majority, against T.N. Seshan.

s: Who of the following was elected President of India unanimously?
x: Neelam Sanjiva Reddy was elected the President of India unanimously (unopposed). His tenure was from 1977 to 1982.

s: Who among the following Chief Justices of India also acted as the President of India?
x: Former Chief Justice of India M. Hidayatullah served as acting President of India from 20 July, 1969 to 24 August, 1969.

s:
Consider the tenure of the following Presidents of India and arrange them in correct chronological order starting from earliest to the last.
1. Neelam Sanjiva Reddy
2. K.R. Narayanan
3. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam
4. R. Venkataraman
Select the correct answer from the code given below:
x: The tenures of the given Presidents are as follows— Neelam Sanjiva Reddy: 25 July 1977 to 25 July 1982 R. Venkataraman: 25 July 1987 to 25 July 1992 K. R. Narayanan: 25 July 1997 to 25 July 2002 A. P. J. Abdul Kalam: 25 July 2002 to 25 July 2007 Hence, the correct chronological order is 1, 4, 2, 3, which is option (a).

s: Who was the candidate of the United Progressive Alliance (UPA) in 15th Presidential Election in India?
x: Yashwant Sinha was the common candidate of the UPA and other opposition parties in the 2022 presidential election, while Droupadi Murmu was the NDA candidate.

s: Who among the following Presidents of India was associated with Trade Union Movement?
x: The fourth president of India, V.V. Giri (1969-1974) was associated with trade union movements. He was also the chairman of the All India Trade Union Congress for two terms.

s: What is the sequence number of Ms. Pratibha Patil as the President of the Republic of India?
x: Pratibha Devi Singh Patil (25 July 2007 to 25 July 2012) took oath as the 12th President of India on 25 July 2007. She was the first woman President of India. According to the tenureorder she was the 14th President of India.

s: Which of the following was elected unopposed as the President of India?
x: N. Sanjiva Reddy is the only President elected unopposed. Rajendra Prasad was elected twice, but with a contest.

s: Which of the following Chief Justice of India acted as the President of India also?
x: M. Hidayatullah is the only CJI to have acted as President (20 July-24 August 1969). The other judges listed never did.

s: Who among the following had the shortest tenure as Indian President?
x: Zakir Husain was President from 1967 and was the first to die in office, in 1969, which gave him a very short tenure. The others served full 5-year terms.

s: Which of the following President of India was associated with Trade Union Movement?
x: V.V. Giri's trade union association is not stated in the notes, so no line is linked. He was the 4th President and a former AITUC chairman.

s: Which of the following Indian President also served as Speaker of Lok Sabha?
x: Neelam Sanjiva Reddy as the sixth President of India, served as a two-time speaker of Lok Sabha from 17 March, 1967 to 19 July, 1969 and from 26 March, 1977 to 13 July, 1977.

s: The single instance of the unanimous election of the President of India so far was the election of –
x: N. Sanjiva Reddy is the only President elected unopposed (unanimously). The others won contested elections.
